run_hierarchical_generation: run the hierarchical transformer generator to produce text from user prompts via the main CLI entry point
load_consolidated_model_and_tokenizer: load a consolidated HierarchicalTransformer model, tokenizer, and regex pool from a checkpoint directory path
create_hierarchical_generator: create a PackedHierarchicalCausalTransformerGenerator with config, model, tokenizer, and regex pool for hierarchical text generation
generate_next_token_hierarchical: generate the next token through the encoder-trunk-decoder hierarchy using level masks and transition modules
prefill_hierarchical_cache: prefill the KV cache across all encoders, trunk, and decoders using pool masks and document lengths
